# Durable Quality

> An independent software studio building Burn, OmniLens, and SpecProof. Quality assured software, built through a different lens.

## Durable Testing

- [Durable Testing](https://durableqa.xyz/durable-testing/llms.txt): testing fundamentals for developers and AI agents: the 7 testing principles, the SDLC and STLC, and the test pyramid.
- [Rules for agents](https://durableqa.xyz/durable-testing/rules.md): the guide's testing rules in one block, for AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.

## Products

- [Burn](https://burnusage.xyz/): a macOS menu bar app that tracks Claude sessions and weekly limits in real time.
- [OmniLens](https://www.omnilens.xyz/): an open-source dashboard for GitHub Actions: success rates, runtimes, and stability trends across every repository.
- [SpecProof](https://specproofoss.vercel.app/): audits every OpenAPI operation against real test assertions, and fails the build when coverage drifts.
